map.有效净水量 Q = 额定净水量 × 水质系数 × 安全余量；可用天数 T = Q: Effective water volume Q = rated capacity × water-quality factor × safety margin; usable days T = Q ÷ daily water use; replacements per year N = 365 ÷ T; annual cost C = N × cartridge price
map.额定净水量是滤芯在实验室条件下的总处理水量。实际水质越差、余氯或泥沙越多，滤芯越: Rated capacity is the total treated water under laboratory conditions. Poorer water quality, more chlorine or sediment means earlier clogging, so a water-quality factor reduces it. The default 90% safety margin replaces the cartridge before capacity runs out, avoiding taste loss or slower flow.

map.典型寿命为常见家用条件下的参考值；实际以滤芯标注的额定净水量、厂商建议和当地水质: Typical life is a reference for common household conditions; actual life depends on the rated capacity on the cartridge, the maker's recommendation and local water quality.
map.额定净水量通常标注在滤芯包装或说明书中，单位可能是升（L）或吨（t），1 t =: Rated capacity is usually printed on the cartridge box or manual, in liters (L) or tonnes (t); 1 t = 1000 L.
map.每日净水用量只统计经过该滤芯的水，包括饮用、煮饭、煲汤与洗菜；洗菜大量用水时请按: Count only water that passes through this filter: drinking, cooking, soup and washing vegetables. Increase the figure when washing vegetables uses a lot of water.
map.水质系数：较好 1.0、一般 0.85、较差 0.70。水质越差，滤芯越容易提前: Water-quality factors: good 1.0, average 0.85, poor 0.70. Poorer water means earlier clogging or saturation.
map.安全余量默认 90%，即用到额定容量的九成就更换；对口感敏感或滤芯价格较低时，可: The default safety margin is 90%, replacing at nine-tenths of rated capacity. For taste-sensitive households or inexpensive cartridges, lower it to 80%-85%.
map.结果为预算与换芯提醒参考，不替代厂商要求；出现出水变慢、异味、TDS 回升等情况: Results are for budget and replacement reminders, not a substitute for the maker's instructions. Replace early if flow slows, odor appears or TDS rises.

map.家庭换芯预算：按额定净水量和每日饮水量算出换芯月份，提前囤货，避免临时买错型号。: Household replacement budget: use rated capacity and daily drinking water to find the replacement month, stock up early and avoid buying the wrong model in a hurry.
map.租房/小户型：每日用水少，滤芯寿命往往按时间先到，而不是按容量用尽；可结合厂商建: Renters/small homes: with low daily use, the time limit often arrives before capacity runs out; combine with the maker's 6-12 month cap.
map.水质较差地区：泥沙、余氯或硬度高会加快堵塞，按较差水质折减，必要时加装前置 PP: Poor water quality areas: sediment, chlorine or hardness speed clogging; use the poor-quality factor and add a pre-filter PP cotton stage if needed.
map.算例：额定 4000 L、每天 8 L、市政自来水、安全余量 90%: Example: rated 4000 L, 8 L/day, municipal tap water, 90% safety margin
map.有效净水量 = 4000 × 0.85 × 0.90 = 3060 L；可用天数: Effective water volume = 4000 × 0.85 × 0.90 = 3060 L; usable days = 3060 ÷ 8 ≈ 383 days; replacements per year ≈ 365 ÷ 383 ≈ 0.95 cartridge/year; at CNY 120 per cartridge, annual cost is about CNY 114 and cost per liter about CNY 0.039.
map.额定净水量和厂商建议的更换周期冲突时听谁的？: What if rated capacity conflicts with the maker's replacement interval?
map.以先到者为准。滤芯标注的额定净水量是容量上限，厂商建议的 6–12 个月是时间上: Whichever comes first. Rated capacity is the volume limit and the maker's 6-12 months is the time limit; even with capacity left, long soaking can breed bacteria or saturate the media.
map.水质系数为什么不是固定的？: Why isn't the water-quality factor fixed?
map.市政自来水的余氯、泥沙和硬度差异很大。水质差时滤芯表面更快形成滤饼、活性炭更快吸: Municipal tap water varies widely in chlorine, sediment and hardness. Poor water forms a cake on the filter and saturates carbon faster, so factors of 1.0, 0.85 and 0.70 bring the estimate closer to reality.
map.默认 90%。对口感敏感、家里有婴幼儿，或滤芯价格不高时，可设 80%–85%: Default 90%. Taste-sensitive households, those with infants, or cheap cartridges can use 80%-85% and replace earlier; with good water and a desire to use full capacity, 95% is acceptable, but do not run to 100% and full clogging.
map.RO 膜也要按这个算吗？: Should RO membranes use this too?
map.可以按额定净水量估算，但 RO 膜还受进水 TDS、温度和产水量影响。若 TDS: Yes, estimate by rated capacity, but RO membranes also depend on feed TDS, temperature and permeate flow. Replace early if TDS rejection clearly drops, permeate flow falls or tank pressure is low; no need to wait for capacity to run out.

map.有效净水量 Q = 额定净水量 × 水质系数 × 安全余量；容量天数 T容量 =: Effective volume Q = rated capacity × water-quality factor × safety margin; capacity days Tcap = Q ÷ daily use; time limit Tmax = manufacturer max months × 30.4167; usable days T = min(Tcap, Tmax); replacements/year N = 365 ÷ T; annual cost C = N × cartridge price; cost per liter uses the water actually treated. The water-quality factor is only an estimate, not a water test.
map.额定净水量是滤芯在实验室条件下的总处理水量。实际水质越差、余氯或泥沙越多，滤芯越: Rated capacity is the total water volume under laboratory conditions. Worse water quality (chlorine, sediment, hardness) clogs the filter earlier, so a water-quality factor is applied. The default 90% safety margin means replacing before the rated capacity is exhausted; the manufacturer max months is a time limit, and the earlier date wins. The water-quality factor is an adjustable estimate and cannot replace a water test.
map.算例：额定 4000 L、每天 8 L、市政自来水、安全余量 90%、厂家最长: Example: rated 4000 L, 8 L/day, municipal water, 90% safety margin, manufacturer max 12 months
map.有效净水量 = 4000 × 0.85 × 0.90 = 3060 L，容量可用: Effective volume = 4000 × 0.85 × 0.90 = 3060 L, giving 3060 ÷ 8 ≈ 383 capacity days; manufacturer max 12 months = 12 × 30.4167 ≈ 365 days, so the earlier 365 days applies; replacements/year = 365 ÷ 365 = 1.00; with a ¥120 cartridge the annual cost is ¥120, and cost per liter = 120 ÷ (8 × 365) ≈ ¥0.041.
map.以先到者为准。滤芯标注的额定净水量是容量上限，厂家建议的 6–12 个月是时间上: Whichever comes first. The rated capacity is the volume limit, while the manufacturer’s 6–12 months is a time limit; enter the “manufacturer max months” and the earlier of capacity and time is used.
